promotion.bet20: The system restricts the threshold and bonus input fields to only accept numeric data to ensure data accuracy and validity.
promotion.bet21: During the settlement process, as long as the corresponding currency threshold is met, the system will automatically distribute the bonus for the respective currency to ensure accurate bonus distribution.
promotion.bet23: Customizable game categories or specific game products to be included in the statistics.
promotion.bet24: Only one option can be selected: either a product type or specific products.
promotion.bet3: Daily Settlement: Data within the activity period is recorded and summarized from 00:00:00 to 23:59:59 each day.
promotion.bet4: Weekly Settlement: Settlement is done on Saturdays each week
promotion.bet5: The first settlement will calculate data from 00:00:00 on the start date of the activity to 23:59:59 on the following Saturday.
promotion.bet6: Subsequent settlements will calculate data from 00:00:00 on Sunday to 23:59:59 on Saturday.
promotion.bet7: Monthly Settlement: Settlements are done at 00:00:00 on the 1st of each month for the previous month, with the settlement range being from the 1st to the 30th/31st of the previous month. If it’s February, the last day will be the 28th or 29th.
promotion.bet8: Distribution Method: After settlement, if the member meets the promotion criteria, it will appear on the [Promotion Review] page, where the agent can choose whether the promotion amount should be manually or automatically distributed.
promotion.bet9: Automatic Distribution: If the conditions are met, the bonus amount will automatically be added to the member's wallet. Distribution will not occur if a block tag is applied.
promotion.custom2: The custom promotion feature only displays relevant text on the promotion page on the member's side. Members must actively contact customer service or inquire with the affiliate to apply for or ask about these promotions, and the system does not have the functionality for automatic settlement or distribution.
promotion.deposit10: In the Deposit and withdrawal review feature, when a Deposit request is approved, the system will check if there are any approved Deposit records with the promotion, as well as whether the manual bonus addition includes this promotion. If such records exist, the promotion will not be processed even if the Deposit request is approved.
promotion.deposit12: For promotions in a disabled state: hide from the member side, suspend settlement, suspend evaluation, and suspend distribution.
promotion.deposit13: Distribution Method: Before settlement, agents can choose automatic distribution. After settlement, if members meet the promotion criteria, the promotion will appear on the [Promotion Review] page, where agents can also manually distribute the bonus amount.
promotion.deposit14: Automatic Distribution: Once the conditions are met, the bonus amount is automatically added to the member's wallet. Distribution is not allowed if a tag block is in place.
promotion.deposit15: Manual Distribution: The affiliate is required to manually select and process the distribution on the Promotion Review page.
promotion.deposit16: Audit Multiplier: Each distributed bonus must be multiplied by the turnover multiplier set by the affiliate and added to the member's withdrawal turnover requirement.
promotion.deposit18: If the settlement meets the promotion criteria, rewards will not be distributed if the member has a block distribution tag. Additionally, the reason for non-distribution will be noted as "Tag Block" in the [Promotion Review List/Reason for Non-Distribution].
promotion.deposit19: During automatic distribution, if the member matches any of the set tags, the system will not distribute the promotion amount.
promotion.deposit2: There are three types of Deposit promotions:
promotion.deposit20: Bind Member Level: The promotion option will only appear on the Deposit page if the member belongs to the specified level.
promotion.deposit21: Restricted Deposit Currency: The promotion option will only appear if the member's Deposit currency matches the currency specified in the promotion.
promotion.deposit22: Deposit Method: The promotion will be displayed based on the payment provider selected by the member. This option is limited to the payment providers set up in the [Payment Management] section on the affiliate side, including payment provider types created by the affiliate.
promotion.deposit23: One-Time Deposit Threshold: The system will immediately verify on the member's Deposit page whether the Deposit amount meets the minimum threshold. If the entered amount is below the set threshold, the related promotion option will automatically become unselectable.
promotion.deposit24: Promotion Amount Setting: The promotion amount can be set as a fixed amount or calculated as a percentage of the Deposit amount. One of these options must be selected.
promotion.deposit3: A one-time promotion that members can apply for each time they make a Deposit. Members can select this promotion on the Deposit page.
promotion.deposit5: The system will check for a first Deposit first Deposit record when the member makes a Deposit. If the timestamp record exists, the promotion will not appear on the member's front-end.
promotion.deposit6: In the Deposit and withdrawal review feature, the system will check the member's first Deposit status when reviewing the Deposit request. If the member does not have a first Deposit record, the system will process the promotion. If the member already has a first Deposit record, the system will not execute the promotion, even if the Deposit request is approved.
promotion.deposit7: The eligibility for the first Deposit is not restricted by currency. As long as the member makes their first Deposit in any currency, it will be considered as using their first Deposit eligibility.
promotion.deposit9: For one-time Deposit promotion, the system will check if the account has a record of the promotion time during the Deposit. If the record exists, the promotion will not be visible to the member on the front-end.
promotion.reg10: Pilih mata wang dan jumlah untuk bonus pendaftaran ini
promotion.reg11: Promosi bonus pendaftaran hanya boleh ditetapkan dengan satu mata wang sahaja.
promotion.reg2: Duplicate Distribution for Same IP Registration
promotion.reg3: Prohibited: When a member successfully registers, the system must check if this IP has already received a distribution. If a distribution has already been made, the [Promotion Review] page will block the distribution, and the prohibition note will display as [Duplicate Registration from Same IP].
promotion.reg4: Not Prohibited: No need to check if a distribution has already been made for this IP.
promotion.reg5: Distribution Method: The affiliate can set up automatic distribution of the registration bonus. After settlement, if the member meets the promotion criteria, the bonus will be automatically distributed, or it will appear on the [Promotion Review] page, where the affiliate can manually select and distribute the promotion amount.
promotion.reg6: Automatic Distribution: If the conditions are met, the promotion amount will be automatically added to the member's wallet. Distribution will not occur if a block tag is applied.
promotion.reg7: Manual Distribution: The affiliate must manually select distribution on the Promotion Review page.
promotion.reg8: Audit Multiplier: Each distributed bonus must be multiplied by this multiplier and added to the member's withdrawal turnover requirement.
